text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I've got some time before bed. Maybe I
can get
some crafting in.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All righty. Let me just get this cloth
ov—oopsie.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My nail caught on the cloth. I wonder if
it's
broken...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, and now the stitch is coming undone. Sigh...
